summary: Ingram Micro filed an 8-K on April 30, 2026, reporting Q1 2026 earnings and other events: a declared cash dividend of $0.084 per share payable May 26, 2026 to holders of record May 12, 2026, and a board-approved increase in its stock repurchase program from $100 million to $175 million for repurchases from affiliates of Platinum Equity. After a March 9, 2026 privately negotiated $75 million repurchase at $21.36/share, $100 million remains available under the program, expiring January 28, 2027. No advisor or recommendation is mentioned. These capital return actions signal a shift toward shareholder distribution; watch for future repurchase execution and dividend policy sustainability.
